package_citation.title: palmerpenguins: Palmer Archipelago (Antarctica) penguin data
package_citation.citation_version_note: The upstream published citation names R package version 0.1.0; the pinned repository DESCRIPTION is version 0.1.1.

original_study.title: Ecological Sexual Dimorphism and Environmental Variability within a Community of Antarctic Penguins (Genus Pygoscelis)

preservation_policy: All public-data derivatives retain all 344 source rows, their order, eight variable meanings, category spellings, numeric values, and missingness. No generated penguin observations, imputation, deduplication, sampling, or rounding are used.
fixture_notice: import_practice_semicolon.csv is a separate original fictional parsing exercise and must not be presented as real Palmer Penguins data.

Parse bill_length_mm and bill_depth_mm as numbers; flipper_length_mm, body_mass_g, and year as integer numbers. Keep category spellings unchanged.
Write an array of 344 record objects with eight fields per object, UTF-8, two-space indentation, and no nonstandard NaN tokens.
Use the same typed records and missing-value conversion as penguins.records.json.

Move the four measurement fields into a measurements object for each record. Keep species, island, sex, and year at the top level. Preserve original row order.
